integration_issues.issue: Hash commit remains intermittent from menu pointer interactions; observed empty-hash outcomes and stale hash carry-over despite valid anchor href targets.

action_items: Stabilize menu anchor pointer path so hash always commits to the clicked route key on first click.
Fix sequential stale-hash transition (Tracks currently inherits #route-cars in observed run).
Fix quick open-click race causing empty hash on first interaction.
Ensure keyboard Space on focused menu anchors activates the intended route same as Enter.
Retest mandatory matrix set after fix: fresh, sequential, quick open-click, Enter/Space, hash key updates, home origin, timeline lock/arrows, gallery/quote/victory, and error/overflow checks.
critical_code_review_comments: Nav link currently combines native href navigation with onClick route mutation and immediate menu close, increasing event-order ambiguity under fast pointer interactions.
Single-line compressed Nav component structure reduces debuggability for click/hash sequencing regressions.
SpatialExperience hash listener appears functional when hash is correct; instability is localized to menu interaction transaction rather than route listener math.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two Playwright runs executed on https://ui-revamp-dynamics.preview.emergentagent.com. Run-1: fresh matrix 1/5 pass, sequential 3/5 pass, quick open-click fail, Enter pass, Space fail, home pass, timeline arrows pass; script stopped at wrong gallery selector then corrected. Run-2: corrected gallery selectors; hash update matrix 3/5 (legacy fail, tracks stale), gallery scroll pass, quote next pass, victory year filter pass, no .error selectors, no horizontal overflow.
rca of the issue: Repro: (1) Load page. (2) Open menu and click Legacy/Cars/Tracks/Victories from fresh sessions; hash often remains empty. (3) In sequential run, Tracks can remain #route-cars. (4) Quick open then immediate Timeline click can produce empty hash. (5) Keyboard Enter works while Space may not route to focused target. RCA: unresolved event ordering in menu interaction path where native anchor navigation and custom onClick hash mutation/close behavior conflict, yielding dropped or stale hash commits under some interaction timings. Mitigation: rely on one deterministic commit path (single source of truth for hash set + close sequencing) and validate Space-key activation parity for anchor controls.
